literal_meaning: ঊনপঞ্চাশে (চল্লিশ নয়ে বা পঞ্চাশের কম) পাওয়া (প্রাপ্ত হওয়া বা আঘাত লাগা)
figurative_meaning_en: to go mad; to be seized by intense fear or frenzy
similar_in_english: to go off the deep end
to take leave of one's senses
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই খবর শুনে তার মাথায় ঊনপঞ্চাশে পড়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has gone mad with grief.
The news hit him so hard that he lost his senses.
history: Referenced in the works of Kazi Nazrul Islam, a prominent Bengali poet and revolutionary, indicating its use in early 20th-century Bengali literature to describe sudden loss of rationality.
note: The idiom draws from the notion of being afflicted by an imaginary '49' ailments or strikes, symbolizing overwhelming mental distress.
